hypotheses.title: Anisotropic Eikonal / Fast-Marching minimum-cost geodesic relays between kinematically compatible tips
layers: NBMG Qfaults vector polylines (slip sense, dip direction, tip azimuth)
H29-1a physical faultness cost field C(x) = -log(eps + P_phys(x))
hypotheses.signature: Curved minimum-energy relay paths following real piedmont scarps and gravity/magnetic gradients between compatible fault terminations.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Replaces ruler-straight T-v2 Euclidean chords (refuted at 0.2449 live) with physically guided curved step-over relays.
hypotheses.confounders: Shortcut routing along unfaulted range-front drainage channels or paleoshorelines between unrelated tips.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Solves anisotropic fast-marching geodesics over physical faultness rather than straight line segments.
hypotheses.cost: medium (deferred cleanly under the strict <=3-experiment Session 6 budget)
hypotheses.validation: Requires fresh unused holdout seed >= 201 before any promotion.

hypotheses.title: 3D Magnetotelluric mid-crustal vertical conductor boundaries + relocated microseismic focal-plane lineations
layers: USArray / USGS ScienceBase 3D Great Basin MT resistivity models (Bedrosian et al.)
Nevada Seismological Laboratory relocated hypocenters (Trugman / NSL catalog)
hypotheses.signature: Sub-vertical crustal resistivity contrasts co-located with planar alignments of relocated M1-M4 microearthquakes at 3-12 km depth projected updip to surface.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: Detects active blind transtensional shear zones (e.g. Dixie Valley / Carson Sink style) with zero surface scarp expression.
hypotheses.confounders: Magmatic/geothermal brine plumes, dipping fault-plane updip projection uncertainty (+/-1-2 km), and sparse MT station spacing (~15-70 km).
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: Uses 3D crustal resistivity gradients + relocated 3D hypocenter plane fitting rather than the 2D smoothed surface conductivity and kernel-density grids in training_features.tif.
hypotheses.cost: high (requires hosted CI retrieval of USGS ScienceBase 3D MT + NSL catalogs)
hypotheses.data_gate: External data blocked in sandbox outbound allowlist; obtainable via hosted GitHub Actions workflow.
hypotheses.validation: Requires fresh unused holdout seed >= 202 after checksum verification.

hypotheses.title: Dilatational-strain and conductivity intersection corridors
hypotheses.signature: Narrow, spatially coincident strain-gradient and conductivity corridors, rather than a high-value threshold on either raster alone.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: A buried active or fluid-bearing strand may have weak surface relief but express local strain concentration and conductive alteration at depth.
hypotheses.confounders: Broad basin conductivity, clay caps, regional strain smoothness, source-depth mismatch, and the fact that a strain anomaly is not a fault trace.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: The current detector uses these layers as scalar channels; no in-repo rule tests their spatial conjunction as a candidate corridor. It is distinct from refuted scalar thermal/radiometric arms and from endpoint graph links.
hypotheses.cost: low-medium; existing raster layers only, but a fold-safe joint-feature definition needs preregistration
hypotheses.data_gate: All listed bands are in the locally restored hash-pinned training-feature mirror.
hypotheses.validation: No run registered yet; use a fresh seed range and preregister the exact transform, controls, and gate against the current-best holdout baseline.

hypotheses.title: Anisotropic seismicity-fabric lineaments
hypotheses.signature: Directional persistence of earthquake-density ridges and their alignment with local shear-rate gradients over scales wider than individual hypocenters.
hypotheses.why_missing_faults: A linear earthquake fabric may expose a blind active strand without a clear young surface scarp.
hypotheses.confounders: Aseismic faults, catalog-completeness gradients, earthquake swarms unrelated to a single fault, and over-smoothed density products.
hypotheses.differs_from_repo: The source channels were included in the scalar model and channel audit, but no directional seismicity-fabric transform has been tested. It differs from the already refuted oriented LiDAR/geophysics line-integral arm in both signal and physical target.
hypotheses.data_gate: Existing hash-pinned raster bands; no new external data.
hypotheses.validation: No run registered yet; preregister a distinct unused seed range and compare against the current-best holdout baseline.
